mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.project_id, m.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.weekly_capacity, m.project_role, m.position, m.can_edit_task, m.can_edit_schedule, m.can_edit_doc, m.can_manage_member, m.joined_at FROM project_member m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY (m.project_role = 'PM') DESC, m.joined_at, m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_member (project_id, user_id, project_role, position, can_edit_task, can_edit_schedule, can_edit_doc, can_manage_member) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{projectRole}, #{position}, #{canEditTask}, #{canEditSchedule}, #{canEditDoc}, #{canManageMember})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_member WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND project_role = #{projectRole}
